qt_exclusion_notice.rationale: Exterior doors are fine-finish substrate exposed to weather and daily physical contact. QT2 is excluded — even budget repaint requires hardware removal, proper substrate-specific prep, and two finish coats. QT3 is minimum viable quality for exterior door repaint.

task_production_rates.name: Visual Condition Assessment Per Door
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~17 min per door. Visual inspection of all surfaces, photograph defects, assign substrate state, record material and complexity. Grand entry takes longer but complexity modifier handles that.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Document obvious defects. Assign substrate state. Photograph major issues.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Systematic scan of all surfaces. Document all visible defects. Confirm adhesion test results.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Exhaustive inspection. Document every defect. Photograph all faces and edges. MC testing on wood.

task_production_rates.name: ASTM D3359 Cross-Hatch Adhesion Test
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~10 min per door. Cross-hatch test at 2 locations minimum (sun-exposed + sheltered face). Score per ASTM D3359 scale.

defect_tolerance.QT3: 2 test locations per door. Rating below 3B triggers full prime.
defect_tolerance.QT4: 3+ test locations per door. Any area of concern gets additional spot test.
defect_tolerance.QT5: 4+ test locations per door. Both faces + edges. Documented with photos.

task_production_rates.name: Rust Evaluation (Steel Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~10 min per door. Probe under existing coating at rust spots. Classify surface rust vs heavy corrosion. Determine SSPC level.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Classify extent as surface vs heavy. Note affected area percentage.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Map all rust spots. Probe for underfilm corrosion spread. Photograph each area.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Exhaustive mapping. Probe all suspect areas. Document depth and spread of each spot.

task_production_rates.name: Moisture Content Testing (Wood Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~10 min per door. Moisture meter readings at bottom rail, end grain, and horizontal surfaces. MC >15% = defer.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Test bottom rail and 1-2 other locations. Record readings.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Test 4+ locations including all end grain. Record all readings.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Test 6+ locations. Both faces, all edges, bottom rail. Document with photos.

task_production_rates.name: Existing Coating Identification
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~5 min per door. Solvent rub test (denatured alcohol or MEK) to identify latex vs oil/alkyd. Quick test on inconspicuous area.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Test 1 location. Determine latex vs oil. Record result.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Test 2 locations (different faces). Confirm coating type.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Test 2+ locations. On fiberglass, verify existing coat is acrylic (oil = failure mode).

task_production_rates.name: Lead Paint Testing (Pre-1978)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed 20 min per project. EPA-recognized lead test on existing coating. Each door tested individually but test kit setup is one-time.

defect_tolerance.QT3: EPA-recognized test performed and documented. Positive triggers RRP module.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT3.

task_production_rates.name: Crew Mobilization & Equipment Staging
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed 30 min per project. Load truck, transport to site, unload and stage all materials, primer, finish, prep tools, protection materials, sawhorses (if spraying).

defect_tolerance.QT3: All materials on-site and verified. Equipment working.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Premium products matched to assessment.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Superior products verified. Extra supplies staged.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Door from Frame
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~15 min per door. Pop hinge pins, lift door off, carry to sawhorses. Grand entry requires 2-person crew (handled by complexity modifier, not crew size change).

defect_tolerance.QT3: Door removed without damage. Set on padded sawhorses.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Frame verified stable.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Protect all edges during transport.

task_production_rates.name: Remove All Door Hardware
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~24 min per door. Remove lockset, deadbolt, strike plates, hinges (if not already removed), address numbers, knocker, peephole, decorative hardware. Bag and label per door. Slab ~20 min, panel ~25 min, grand entry ~30 min — complexity modifier handles scaling.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All hardware removed and bagged. No damage to door surface during removal.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. All fastener holes accessible for sealing.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Hardware pieces individually wrapped to prevent scratches.

task_production_rates.name: Weatherstrip Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~12 min per door. Pull out friction-fit weatherstripping from frame groove or push masking tape deep into gap with putty knife. Full perimeter.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Weatherstrip fully protected. No paint contamination risk.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Verify no exposed seal material.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Extra care to avoid deforming seal during removal.

task_production_rates.name: Threshold / Sill Plate Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~7.5 min per door. Apply masking tape and paper to door threshold/sill plate. Full width coverage.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Threshold covered. Edges sealed to prevent seepage.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT3.

task_production_rates.name: Glass Lite Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~7.5 min per lite. Mask each glass lite individually with masking paper or pre-taped film. Rate is per lite, not per door. Grand entry with sidelites = 4-8 lites.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Glass fully covered. Tape pressed to muntin/frame edge.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Clean tape lines for sharp paint edge at glass.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Verified seal — no seepage risk.

task_production_rates.name: Ground / Hardscape Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~200 SF/hr. Deploy canvas drop cloth under door work zone. Brush: edge-only (3-4 ft, ~15 SF). Spray on sawhorses: full tarp (~60 SF). Secure edges.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Ground covered. No trip hazard. Edges secured.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT3.

task_production_rates.name: Siding Masking (Spray Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~20 min per door opening. Mask siding 12-24 inches from door opening with paper/film and tape. Spray only — brush does not generate overspray.

defect_tolerance.QT3: No exposed siding within spray fan pattern.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Clean tape lines at door-siding junction.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed 45 min per project. Deploy 6-mil poly sheeting 10 ft from door work zone per EPA RRP rule. Secure perimeter. Close nearby windows/doors.

defect_tolerance.QT3: EPA-compliant 10 ft perimeter. All seams sealed. Ground fully covered.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT3.

task_production_rates.name: Wet Method Preparation for Lead Paint
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed 20 min per project. Set up misting system or hand sprayers for wet scraping. Stage HEPA vacuum at work position. Wet methods mandatory for all lead paint disturbance.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Wet methods active. HEPA vacuum staged. No dry scraping.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT3.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Teardown & Waste Disposal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed 45 min per project. Fold containment inward, bag all waste in labeled lead-safe bags, HEPA vacuum entire area, dispose per EPA RRP.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All containment folded inward. HEPA vacuumed. Waste bagged, labeled, and disposed per EPA.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT3.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Steel Door — Solvent + TSP
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~17 min per door. Solvent clean (xylene/acetone) to cut grease, followed by TSP detergent wash, rinse, and dry. Two-step process on steel.

defect_tolerance.QT3: No visible grease, oil, or contaminants. Surface dulled by TSP wash.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Verify no residue with white-cloth wipe.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Multiple wipe verifications.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Fiberglass Door — Mild Soap Only
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~12 min per door. Mild dish soap or denatured alcohol only. NO hydrocarbon solvents (xylene, acetone, MEK, lacquer thinner) — irreversible resin damage. Gentler process than steel.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Clean surface. No residue. No solvent damage.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Verify with clean-cloth wipe.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Wood Door — TSP Wash
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~17 min per door. TSP wash to remove dirt, mildew, contaminants. Light pressure only — do not force water into joints or end grain. 24-48 hr dry time required before coating.

defect_tolerance.QT3: No visible dirt or mildew. No water forced into joints.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Verify all panel recesses cleaned.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Document mildew locations if found.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape Failing Paint & Feather-Sand Edges

QT3.notes: ~30 min/EA. Scrape to solid edge, feather-sand all transitions. 80-120 grit.

QT4.notes: ~40 min/EA. Thorough scrape. Feather 3-4 inches from paint edge. Test transition zones.

QT5.notes: ~60 min/EA. Aggressive scrape — remove all questionable adhesion. Feather to imperceptible gradient.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Scrape all loose/flaking paint with carbide scrapers. Feather-edge sand ALL scraped areas. Rate depends heavily on condition — FAC_DRRP_CONDITION modifier handles scaling. Base rate assumes moderate failing area (~20-30%).

defect_tolerance.QT3: No loose paint remaining. Feathered transitions. Smooth hand-feel at edges.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Raking light check on transitions. 3-4 inch feather zone.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Zero loose paint. Imperceptible transition from paint to bare. Multiple grit progression.

task_production_rates.name: Adhesion Scuff Sand

QT3.notes: ~24 min/EA. Break gloss on existing finish. 150-grit. Consistent dull appearance.

QT4.notes: ~30 min/EA. Full degloss. Uniform scratch pattern. No skipped areas.

QT5.notes: ~40 min/EA. Complete degloss. 180-grit for finer scratch pattern compatible with gloss topcoat.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Light scuff sand on intact existing paint for adhesion tooth. 150-180 grit. Applied to non-scraped areas. Skips textured fiberglass (per AR_DRRP_007).

defect_tolerance.QT3: Gloss broken. Uniform dull appearance across sanded areas.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete degloss. Even scratch pattern. No glossy spots missed.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Full degloss with 180-grit. Uniform fine scratch. Compatible with gloss topcoat adhesion.

task_production_rates.name: Rust Debridement — SSPC-SP3/SP6

QT3.notes: ~40 min/EA. Remove all active rust to bare metal. Feather with 300-grit. SSPC-SP3 power tool cleaning.

QT4.notes: ~60 min/EA. Complete debridement. Probe for underfilm corrosion. Smooth transition zones.

QT5.notes: ~80 min/EA. Aggressive debridement. No trace of rust. May require multiple passes. SSPC-SP6 commercial blast if needed.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Highly variable — depends on rust extent. Base rate assumes moderate surface rust (~10-20% of door area). Severe corrosion will trigger FAC_DRRP_CONDITION modifier (2.0x). Steel doors only.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All active rust removed to bare metal. 300-grit feather at edges.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. No underfilm corrosion remaining. Smooth transitions.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Zero rust tolerance. Mirror-smooth debridement. Multiple grit progression to 300+.

task_production_rates.name: Body Filler — Dent & Imperfection Repair
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~24 min per door. Mix 2-component body filler, apply to dents, rough-sand 80-grit, finish-sand 240/300-grit. QT4: visible dents only. QT5: all imperfections including minor divots.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Visible dents filled and smooth to touch. Verify with raking light.
defect_tolerance.QT5: ALL imperfections filled. Mirror-smooth surface. Multiple fill/sand cycles if needed.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk Door-to-Frame Junction

QT3.notes: ~15 min/EA. Replace failed caulk. Continuous bead. Tool smooth.

QT4.notes: ~20 min/EA. Replace all caulk. Consistent bead width. Clean tool lines.

QT5.notes: ~24 min/EA. Complete caulk replacement. Perfect bead. Invisible after painting.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Remove failed existing caulk, clean joint, apply new exterior-grade paintable caulk (polyurethane or hybrid MS), tool to concave profile. NEVER silicone.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Failed caulk replaced. Continuous bead. No gaps. Tooled smooth.
defect_tolerance.QT4: All caulk replaced. Consistent width. Clean tool lines. No excess.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Complete replacement. Perfect concave profile. Invisible under paint.

task_production_rates.name: Six-Side Seal Verification (Wood Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~5 min per door. With door removed, verify all six sides accessible for coating. Bottom edge end-grain gets extra attention. Quick inspection task.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All six sides accessible. Previously unsealed edges noted.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Document with photos.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Bottom edge condition rated and documented.

task_production_rates.name: Sanding Dust Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~6 min per door. Tack cloth all surfaces including edges and panel recesses. Critical for adhesion and finish quality. Performed after all sanding, before any coating.

defect_tolerance.QT3: No visible dust. Tack cloth wipe on all faces.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Include edges and panel recesses. No dust nibs.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Multiple tack cloth passes. White-glove clean. Zero dust tolerance.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Prime Steel — Acrylic DTM Brush

QT3.notes: ~30 min/EA. Spot prime bare/thin areas. Feather into existing coating.

QT4.notes: ~40 min/EA. Full coverage of bare areas. Smooth transition at edges.

QT5.notes: ~48 min/EA. Full coverage. Even film build. No lap marks.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Brush-apply acrylic DTM primer to bare/thin areas on factory-primed/sound steel. Not for rusted areas. Rate assumes ~20-30% bare area. Full prime scenarios will trend toward low end of range.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All bare areas covered. Feathered edges.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Full coverage. Smooth transition. Uniform mil build.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Full coverage. Even film build. No lap marks or brush lines.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Prime Steel — Acrylic DTM Spray

QT3.notes: ~20 min/EA. Even coverage of bare areas.

QT4.notes: ~24 min/EA. Uniform mil build. No overspray on intact coating.

QT5.notes: ~30 min/EA. Precise spray pattern. Even film build.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Spray-apply acrylic DTM primer. Door must be removed and on sawhorses. Faster than brush but requires setup overhead already captured in door removal task.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Even coverage. No holidays on bare areas.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform mil build. No overspray on intact coating areas.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Precise spray. Even film build. Multiple light passes.

task_production_rates.name: Zinc-Rich Primer on Bare Debrided Steel — Brush

QT3.notes: ~30 min/EA. Full coverage of debrided areas. Even film build on bare metal.

QT4.notes: ~40 min/EA. Complete coverage. Feather into surrounding DTM primer.

QT5.notes: ~48 min/EA. Complete coverage. Verify no holidays on bare metal.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Brush-apply zinc-rich epoxy/alkyd primer to bare metal exposed by rust debridement. Sacrificial barrier primer. Applied to bare metal only. Steel + SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST only.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Full coverage on all debrided areas. Even film build.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage. Uniform mil build. Feathered into surrounding primer.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Complete coverage. No holidays on bare metal. Premium application verified.

task_production_rates.name: Zinc-Rich Primer on Bare Debrided Steel — Spray

QT3.notes: ~20 min/EA. Full coverage of debrided areas.

QT4.notes: ~24 min/EA. Uniform mil build. Complete coverage.

QT5.notes: ~30 min/EA. Multiple light passes for even build.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Spray-apply zinc-rich primer to debrided bare metal. Door must be removed and on sawhorses.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Full coverage on all debrided areas.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform mil build. Complete coverage.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Premium application. Multiple light passes. No holidays.

task_production_rates.name: Prime Wood/Fiberglass — Acrylic Primer Brush

QT3.notes: ~30 min/EA. Cover bare areas. Work into grain (wood). Even film build.

QT4.notes: ~40 min/EA. Full coverage. Uniform mil build. Back-brush grain areas (wood).

QT5.notes: ~48 min/EA. Premium application. Back-brush for penetration. No holidays.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Brush-apply 100% acrylic exterior primer on wood or fiberglass. Spot prime if sound, full prime if >30% bare. Fiberglass: 100% acrylic ONLY.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All bare areas covered. Primer worked into grain (wood).
defect_tolerance.QT4: Full coverage. Uniform build. Back-brushed grain areas.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Complete coverage. Premium application. No holidays. Full penetration.

task_production_rates.name: Prime Wood/Fiberglass — Acrylic Primer Spray

QT3.notes: ~20 min/EA. Even coverage. Back-brush bare wood areas.

QT4.notes: ~24 min/EA. Uniform mil build. Back-brush all grain areas.

QT5.notes: ~30 min/EA. Multiple passes. Back-brush for full penetration.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Spray-apply 100% acrylic primer on wood or fiberglass. Door must be removed and on sawhorses. Back-brushing recommended for bare wood grain areas.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Even coverage. Back-brushed bare wood.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform mil build. Back-brushed all grain areas.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Premium application. Multiple passes. Full penetration on bare wood.

task_production_rates.name: Stain-Block Primer — Tannin-Rich Wood Brush

QT3.notes: ~34 min/EA. Full coverage of tannin-affected areas. Seal all exposed tannin-rich wood.

QT4.notes: ~40 min/EA. Uniform film build. Verify no bleed-through after dry.

QT5.notes: ~48 min/EA. Complete coverage. Verify seal with test wipe after cure.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Brush-apply alkyd or shellac stain-blocking primer on tannin-rich wood (cedar, redwood, mahogany). Slower than standard acrylic primer due to product handling (alkyd/shellac) and critical coverage requirements.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Full coverage of all exposed tannin-rich wood. Sealed grain.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform film build. No bleed-through after dry.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Complete coverage. Verified seal with test wipe. Premium application.

task_production_rates.name: Second Primer Coat (QT5)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~40 min per door. Second primer coat at QT5 for maximum hide and adhesion base under gloss topcoat. Light sand (180-220) between primer coats. Same rate as first primer QT5 pass.

defect_tolerance.QT5: Full coverage. No holidays or thin areas. Verified even build. Sanded between coats.

task_production_rates.name: Between-Coat Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~10 min per door. Inspect previous coat for runs, sags, holidays, dust nibs, brush marks, orange peel. Mark defects. Per interstage cycle (run_count = total_coats - 1).

defect_tolerance.QT4: Visual inspection in natural light. Runs, sags, holidays marked.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Raking light at all angles. ALL defects including dust nibs, brush marks, orange peel. Zero tolerance at gloss.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Light Sand
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~17 min per door. Light sand between coats. QT4: 150-grit between finish coats. QT5: 180-220 grit between ALL coats. Tack cloth after. Per interstage cycle.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Even scratch pattern. All nibs removed. Tack-clothed after.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Uniform 180-220 grit scratch. Multiple tack cloth passes. No nibs remaining.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Spot Repair
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~15 min per door. Repair defects from inspection: sand runs/sags, touch up holidays, re-coat thin areas. Must cure before next coat. Per interstage cycle. Actual time varies widely — some cycles have no defects.

defect_tolerance.QT4: All marked defects repaired. Feathered into surrounding coat.
defect_tolerance.QT5: ALL defects repaired. Verified smooth to touch. Re-inspected after dry.

task_production_rates.name: First Finish Coat — Brush

QT3.notes: ~34 min/EA. Even coverage. Maintain wet edge. All edges covered.

QT4.notes: ~45 min/EA. Uniform film build. Clean lines. No lap marks.

QT5.notes: ~60 min/EA. Premium brush technique. Flowed finish. Minimal brush marks. All six sides on wood.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Brush-apply first finish topcoat. Work in sections for wet edge. Follow grain on wood. Sash brush at frame junctions. Cover slab face, frame/jamb, all edges. Slab baseline ~30-35 min per doctrine.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Even coverage. Wet edge maintained. No holidays. All edges coated.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform film build. Clean lines at junctions. No lap marks.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Flowed finish. Near-zero brush marks. All six sides on wood.

task_production_rates.name: First Finish Coat — Spray

QT3.notes: ~20 min/EA. Even pass. Consistent mil build. All faces and edges.

QT4.notes: ~24 min/EA. Uniform coverage. No runs or sags. Spray panel recesses.

QT5.notes: ~30 min/EA. Premium spray technique. Multiple light passes for flow. All six sides on wood.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Spray-apply first finish topcoat. Door removed and on sawhorses. Consistent distance and speed. All faces and edges. Spray ~15-25 min per doctrine. No backbrushing needed on doors.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Even pass. All edges and faces covered. No runs.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform coverage. No runs or sags. All panel recesses coated.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Premium spray. Multiple light passes. Near-zero orange peel. All six sides on wood.

task_production_rates.name: Second Finish Coat — Brush

QT3.notes: ~34 min/EA. Even coverage. Final appearance coat.

QT4.notes: ~45 min/EA. Uniform film build. Semi-gloss must be flawless.

QT5.notes: ~60 min/EA. Premium flowed finish. Near-zero brush marks. Gloss is unforgiving.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Second finish topcoat by brush. Final appearance coat — highest quality attention. Same rate as first coat — second coat has same technique requirements.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Even coverage. No holidays. Inspect as you go.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform film build. Clean lines. Flawless semi-gloss.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Premium flowed finish. Near-zero brush marks. Fresh brush if needed.

task_production_rates.name: Second Finish Coat — Spray

QT3.notes: ~20 min/EA. Even pass. Final appearance coat.

QT4.notes: ~24 min/EA. Uniform coverage. Self-inspect each face.

QT5.notes: ~30 min/EA. Premium spray. Multiple light passes for flow. Near-zero orange peel.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Second finish topcoat by spray. Final appearance coat. Same rate as first coat.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Even pass. Final appearance coat. All edges covered.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform coverage. Self-inspect each face.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Premium spray. Multiple light passes. Near-zero orange peel.

task_production_rates.name: Rehang Door in Frame
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~20 min per door. Rehang on hinges, adjust alignment, verify close and latch. Grand entry requires 2-person lift (complexity modifier handles rate adjustment). Conditional — only if door was removed.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Door closes and latches. Adequate clearances. No binding on fresh paint.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Even clearance on all sides.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Perfect alignment. No rubbing marks on finish.

task_production_rates.name: Reinstall All Door Hardware
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~24 min per door. Reinstall lockset, deadbolt, strike plates, hinges (if applicable), address numbers, decorative hardware. Verify all locking mechanisms operational. Protect fresh paint with cloth during insertion.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All hardware installed and operational. No scratches on fresh paint.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Lock and latch verified. Alignment checked.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Zero scratches. Protective cloth used throughout.

task_production_rates.name: Weatherstrip Reinstallation
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ~10 min per door. Re-insert friction-fit weatherstripping or remove deep-tape masking. Verify seal contact around full perimeter. Check for paint contamination.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Full perimeter seal. No gaps. Weatherstrip compresses evenly.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Verify no paint on weatherstrip.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Clean any contamination.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Protection — Masking & Ground Cover
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed 25 min per project. Remove all masking tape, paper, film from glass lites, threshold, siding. Remove ground cover and drop cloths. Fold and bag debris. Time varies with scope of masking deployed.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All masking removed. No tape residue. No fresh paint pulled.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Glass checked for adhesive residue.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Clean all adhesive residue.

task_production_rates.name: Final Inspection

QT3.notes: ~10 min/EA. Visual inspection. Check holidays, runs, inconsistent coverage.

QT4.notes: ~15 min/EA. Close inspection at arm's length. Check lines, transitions, coverage uniformity.

QT5.notes: ~24 min/EA. Raking light at all angles. Zero-defect standard for gloss. Verify six-side seal on wood.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Final inspection of all surfaces. Higher QT = more thorough inspection with tighter defect tolerance.

defect_tolerance.QT3: No obvious holidays, runs, or missed areas. Hardware operates.
defect_tolerance.QT4: No defects visible at arm's length. Clean lines. All edges coated. Uniform sheen.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Zero-defect under raking light at all angles. Perfect sheen uniformity. Six-side seal verified on wood.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-Up Defects

QT3.notes: ~10 min/EA. Repair holidays and runs. Blend into surrounding finish.

QT4.notes: ~15 min/EA. Repair all marked defects. Invisible repairs required.

QT5.notes: ~30 min/EA. Repair all defects. Re-inspect after each. May require local re-coat for invisible repair at gloss.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per door. Touch up defects from final inspection. Higher QT = more defects found = more touch-up time. QT5 gloss may require local re-coat for invisible repair.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Holidays and runs repaired. Blended into surrounding finish.
defect_tolerance.QT4: All defects repaired. Invisible repairs.
defect_tolerance.QT5: All defects repaired. Re-inspected. Local re-coat if needed. Invisible at gloss sheen.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Tools & Equipment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed 20 min per project. Clean brushes, spray equipment (if used), scrapers. Store or dispose. Flush sprayer with appropriate cleaner.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Equipment cleaned. Sprayer flushed. Brushes stored or disposed.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT3.

task_production_rates.name: Waste Disposal & Site Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed 15 min per project. Collect all waste: masking, plastic, cans, sandpaper, caulk tubes. Leave site clean. RRP waste handled separately.

defect_tolerance.QT3: No debris on site. All materials removed.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT3.

task_production_rates.name: Final Customer Walkthrough
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed 15 min per project. Walk completed work with customer. Demonstrate hardware operation. Point out completed work. Discuss maintenance expectations.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Hardware demonstrated. Work pointed out. Maintenance discussed.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Same as QT3. Document acceptance.
defect_tolerance.QT5: Same as QT4. Written punch list if any items noted.

factor_modifiers.description: Quality tier rate modifier on coating tasks (prime, finish)
factor_modifiers.notes: QT3 = baseline (standard product + 2 coats). QT4 = premium (25% slower — raking light inspection, semi-gloss demands clean technique). QT5 = superior (50% slower — sanding between coats, multiple light passes, gloss magnifies imperfections). Applied as: effective_rate = base_rate / FAC_DRRP_QT.

factor_modifiers.description: Door complexity multiplier on ALL tasks
factor_modifiers.notes: Slab = flat face, minimal detail, single lockset. Panel = recesses, raised profiles, multiple edges, glass lites. Grand entry = sidelites + transom + complex geometry + multiple glass lites + 2-person crew for removal. Applied universally. effective_rate = base_rate / FAC_DRRP_COMPLEXITY.

factor_modifiers.description: Substrate condition modifier on PREP tasks only
factor_modifiers.notes: Sound paint = baseline prep (scuff sand, clean). Failing paint = 50% more time (scraping, feather-sanding, more primer coverage). Surface rust = 100% more time (SSPC debridement, multiple grits, body fill). Does NOT apply to coating tasks — prep normalizes the surface. SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is steel-only. effective_rate = base_rate / FAC_DRRP_CONDITION.

factor_modifiers.description: Lead-safe RRP regulatory modifier on PREP tasks only
factor_modifiers.notes: Gate triggered by IN_BOOL_PRE_1978 = true AND positive lead test. Doubles prep task time due to wet scraping methods, HEPA vacuum requirements, containment maintenance, and lead-safe disposal overhead. Does NOT apply to coating tasks. effective_rate = base_rate / FAC_DRRP_RRP.

max_theoretical_stacking.prep_worst_case: SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST (2.00) x RRP (2.00) x grand_entry (2.00) = 8.00x — EXCEEDS 4.0x cap. Recommend T&M pricing for this combination.
max_theoretical_stacking.notes: Grand entry + rust + RRP (8.0x) is an extreme edge case that should trigger T&M recommendation in the estimation engine. Typical stacking for standard door repaint stays well within 4.0x threshold.

quality_effects.notes: Spot prime bare areas + 2 finish coats. No interstage sanding. Production pace. Steel limited to satin per ANSI A250.8.
Spot/full prime + interstage between all coats + 2 finish coats. Body filler for dents (steel). Semi-gloss reveals more defects — slower pace.

2-coat primer + interstage between ALL coats + 2 finish coats. Body filler for all imperfections. Gloss sheen demands flawless surface. Grand entry at QT5 with failing paint = full restoration (12-20 hrs/EA).

time_estimate_summary.description: Approximate total hours per door at slab/panel complexity, sound paint, brush application — before modifiers

QT3_slab_sound_brush.notes: Within doctrine range of 2.5-4.5 hrs for 6-panel repaint after complexity modifier applied. Slab base at ~5 hrs is higher because this includes all assessment and mobilization overhead. With slab complexity (1.0x) and sound condition (1.0x), the rate is reasonable.

QT5_grand_entry_failing_brush.notes: Restoration territory. Grand entry (2.0x) + failing (1.5x on prep) + QT5 (1.5x on coating) + 2-coat primer + 3 interstage cycles. Within doctrine range of 12-20 hrs for restoration.

assumptions.value: EA-based rates calibrated to slab door baseline
assumptions.source: Exterior Doors Doctrine production rate tables
assumptions.note: All rates are per-door (EA). Slab is the baseline; panel and grand entry scale via FAC_DRRP_COMPLEXITY modifier. Rates assume single door in scope — multi-door projects benefit from batch efficiencies not captured here.

assumptions.value: Spray is ~1.5x faster than brush for prime and finish tasks
assumptions.source: Exterior Application Methods Doctrine, Exterior Doors Doctrine
assumptions.note: Spray rates account for door being removed and on sawhorses. Setup overhead (door removal, siding masking) is captured in separate tasks. Net spray advantage is modest because door surfaces are small relative to setup.

assumptions.value: Mobilization, RRP containment, protection teardown, equipment cleaning, waste disposal, walkthrough use FIXED time
assumptions.source: Estimation Engineer judgment based on project-level (not per-unit) nature of these tasks
assumptions.note: These tasks do not scale linearly with door count. For multi-door projects, these fixed times may need adjustment upward but not proportionally.
QT4: interstage between prime/finish1 and finish1/finish2. QT5: adds interstage between primer coats (2-coat primer system). Each cycle = inspect + sand + spot repair.

assumptions.source: Exterior Doors Doctrine — single door is a one-person task
assumptions.note: Grand entry door removal/rehang may need 2-person crew due to weight. This is handled by the complexity modifier (2.0x) which accounts for the extra labor, not by changing crew_size.

risks.description: Grand entry + rust + RRP stacking exceeds 4.0x modifier cap (8.0x theoretical)
risks.mitigation: Estimation engine should flag this combination for T&M pricing. Production rates become unreliable at 8.0x stacking — too many compounding variables.

risks.description: Fiberglass cleaning rate may be too fast if textured fiberglass has deep grain requiring extra scrubbing
risks.mitigation: Field calibration needed. Textured fiberglass (faux wood grain) may need 15-20 min vs 12 min for smooth fiberglass.

risks.description: Rust debridement rate highly variable depending on rust extent and depth
risks.mitigation: Base rate assumes moderate surface rust. Severe corrosion (SSPC-SP6) could triple the base time. FAC_DRRP_CONDITION (2.0x) may not be sufficient for worst cases.

risks.description: Multi-door projects have batch efficiencies not captured in per-door rates
risks.mitigation: For 3+ door projects, a batch discount factor (0.85-0.90x) could be applied to mobilization, protection, and cleanup tasks. Not implemented in this version.

validation_plan.description: Time single slab steel door at QT3 with sound paint, brush application
validation_plan.notes: Slab at QT3 sound should be the fastest repaint. Within doctrine 1.0-2.0 hr range for slab NC, but repaint adds 30-100% overhead.

validation_plan.description: Time 6-panel steel door at QT3 with failing paint, brush application
validation_plan.notes: Panel (1.3x) + failing (1.5x on prep) should land in doctrine 2.5-4.5 hr range for 6-panel repaint.

validation_plan.description: Time grand entry wood door at QT5 with failing paint, brush application
validation_plan.notes: Restoration territory. Grand entry (2.0x) + failing (1.5x) + QT5 (1.5x) + 2-coat primer + 3 interstage cycles. Should match doctrine 12-20 hrs for restoration.

validation_plan.description: Compare spray vs brush total time on same door
validation_plan.expected_range: Spray should be 20-30% faster on prime+finish, but offset by door removal + siding masking
validation_plan.notes: Net spray advantage on a single door may be minimal due to setup overhead. Spray becomes more advantageous on multi-door projects.

validation_plan.description: Validate hardware remove + reinstall total time
validation_plan.notes: Should match doctrine 15-30 min remove + 15-25 min reinstall range.
